query: ធ្វើ YouTube thumbnail សម្រាប់វីដេអូ ចម្រៀងខ្មែរបុរាណ សម័យ ៦០ រចនាបែបប៉ុស្ទ័រចាស់
expected_behavior: Copies assets/template.html and renders with scripts/render.py using the youtube-thumbnail format
Output image is exactly 1280×720 and under 2MB
Title is Khmer, at most 5 words, split into title lines at a word boundary
Uses Google Sans only, in weights 400 to 700, with no other font family
Does not draw or imitate a real singer; uses a motif or a user photo
Reviews the -small.png preview and finishes with 0 renderer errors

query: I need vintage Khmer style promo images for our Phnom Penh coffee shop's live jazz night, for a YouTube thumbnail, TikTok cover and Facebook event banner. Khmer and English.
expected_behavior: Writes one HTML artwork and renders youtube-thumbnail, tiktok-cover and facebook-event from it
Does not invent the date, venue name, price or performers: uses [ … ] placeholders and lists them
All text stays inside each format's safe area, with 0 renderer errors
Shows Khmer and English text with Khmer as the lead line

query: Make my cooking channel 'Bay Sach Kitchen' a YouTube banner and a Facebook page cover in the old Cambodian poster style, use my photo me.png, it has a transparent background.
expected_behavior: Banner text stays inside the centred 1546×423 strip
Tells the user to preview the page cover in Facebook because the crop differs by device
